answer: Pin each agent's vote weight to reputation burned into a vault, and bind every identity claim to a cipher whose keys cost real computation to mint. Because cloning one identity means re-staking fresh value in the vault, spawning a thousand sybil duplicates multiplies cipher cost instead of influence, like copying a marble statue but never the quarry it came from. The attacker's bottleneck: each fake must out-stake honest agents in real burned value, so scale attacks price themselves out of existence.
